fs_password = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_login = apis.file_system.login(username='ed_wilson@gmail.com', password=fs_password)
fs_access_token = fs_login['access_token']
print('fs_access_token_set', bool(fs_access_token))

# Search for headshot files
page_results = []
# show_directory returns list of strings; we just fetch recursively from home root
headshot_entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_access_token, directory_path='~/', substring='headshot', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
print('headshot_entries_count', len(headshot_entries))
print(headshot_entries)

# Verify headshot file exists, then send email to manager with attachment
headshot_path = "/home/edwin/documents/work/professional_headshot.jpeg"
file_exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=headshot_path, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('file_exists', file_exists_resp)

gmail_password = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
gmail_login_resp = apis.gmail.login(username='ed_wilson@gmail.com', password=gmail_password)
gmail_access_token = gmail_login_resp['access_token']
print('gmail_login_ok', bool(gmail_access_token))

manager_email = manager_contacts[0]['email']
print('manager_email', manager_email)

subject = 'Professional Headshot'
body = "Hi Jose,\n\nAttached is my professional headshot for your records.\n\nBest,\nEdwin"

send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=[manager_email],
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_access_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[headshot_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_access_token
)
print('send_resp', send_resp)
